松岸 · Pinewater
场景几何、摄影纹理校准、动画、湖水、镜头和影片为本次重建制作。构图与可见物体纹理依据随附参考图。

The trail-shoe scan was scaled, mirrored, retinted and adapted to a load-bearing sole. Full credits for the footwear and cloth are in art/walker-CREDITS.txt.

离开首帧机位后新显露的木纹、地表与水中入射光，部分采用本次生成的辅助视图校准。影片由同一三维场景逐帧渲染。

第一人称镜头的步态和落脚缓冲参考 Carnegie Mellon University Motion Capture Database 的 113_25（平地行走）及 113_19（下阶）。
The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
https://mocap.cs.cmu.edu/
The camera uses fitted head-motion coefficients retargeted to the measured path, canoe and foot contacts.
